title: Academic Misconduct Concerns
question: Will using this service be flagged as academic misconduct by my university?
answer: Our services focus strictly on technical improvements: reducing textual similarity, correcting grammar, and fixing formatting. We do not engage in 'ghostwriting' or adding new research content. Most universities allow professional editing; however, we strongly recommend checking your specific institution's guidelines on external proofreading services.

title: Repository vs Non-Repository
question: What is the difference between 'Repository' and 'Non-Repository' checks?
answer: A 'Repository' check saves your work in Turnitin's database, meaning future checks will flag it as 100% plagiarized. We ONLY use 'Non-Repository' settings, so your document remains private and will NOT be matched against itself when you officially submit it to your university later.

title: AI Detector Discrepancies
question: Why does my AI score differ between Turnitin and other tools like GPTZero or any other AI detection tools?
answer: Different AI detectors use different algorithms and datasets. Turnitin's model is specifically trained on academic writing, while other AI detection tools are more general. Our AI reduction service targets the most rigorous academic standards to ensure your content sounds natural and original across multiple platforms.
